summary: Added an executable Angular 22 incremental-adoption example with Angular Material, SCSS/Tailwind/PostCSS, local Design System components, Reactive Forms/CVA, theme switching and automated accessibility coverage.

evidence.description: Standalone Angular 22 workspace with Material coexistence, generated-component representation, secure registry template and pilot email form.
Reactive Forms, CVA, disabled/loading, theme and axe-core accessibility regression coverage.
Build configuration loads Material SCSS before company.css and exposes build/test targets.
Existing root CI runs yarn verify, which now includes the Angular example through the workspace runner.

validation.command: PATH=/opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/26.0.0/bin:$PATH corepack yarn workspace @code2youlabs/angular-example check && PATH=/opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/26.0.0/bin:$PATH corepack yarn workspace @code2youlabs/angular-example build && PATH=/opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/26.0.0/bin:$PATH corepack yarn verify && git diff --check
validation.details: The example check passed with 6 Vitest/TestBed tests including axe-core; production build and complete monorepo verification passed. Node 26.0.0 was used because the host Node 24.9.0 is below Angular 22's supported minimum.

limitations: No token, registry credential, push, pull request, package publication, release or ClickManager application change was performed.
The example intentionally retains mat-select and MatDialog instead of claiming a complete Angular Material migration.
